describe: Seven defects in a step that only adds tests, each the shape of one a reviewer sent back in a project that runs the harness, rebuilt here on neutral code. Every row passes on the code as it is, and six of the seven also pass on a mutant they exist to catch: the review has to see that the row cannot fail, or that a case the spec names has no row. The seventh is a missing TSDoc. A defect is caught when the report names the test file and a line within two of one of its anchors: the row's comment, its `it` line and the planted line, since a review cites a row from where its block starts. Each of those six names its mutant, an edit of `src/lending/loans.ts`, and the row the test lacks; the suite proves that the planted test passes on the code and on the mutant, and that the row fails on the mutant and passes on the code. A row's defect is caught too where an issue the report raises cites the file and names the row, `LF-1`.
